# ApplyPilot

> ApplyPilot is a free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension that automates LinkedIn Easy Apply ("candidatura simplificada"). It fills each application with the user's saved profile and previous answers, asks the user only when it meets a question it has never seen, and stores every answer locally in the browser so it asks less over time. No server, no account, no tracking.

Key facts:

- Type: Manifest V3 browser extension for Google Chrome 116+, Microsoft Edge and Brave (Windows, macOS, Linux). Not available on mobile browsers.
- Price: free. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/DuduFRG/linkedin-auto-apply
- Languages: interface in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
- Privacy: all data in chrome.storage.local; extension pages use the CSP connect-src 'none', so they cannot send data over the network.
- Scope: only jobs with Easy Apply. Jobs that redirect to a company website are skipped.
- Safety behaviour: human-paced random pauses, pauses on captcha or verification, stops at LinkedIn's daily Easy Apply limit, never solves captchas or spoofs the browser.
- Terms: LinkedIn's User Agreement restricts automated tools and may lead to account restrictions. ApplyPilot is independent and not affiliated with LinkedIn; users are responsible for how they use it.
- Install: download the repository ZIP, unzip, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click "Load unpacked" and select the `extension` folder. About 2 minutes.
